explication: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model. The principal workflow starts with a user supplying univariate or multivariate context, optional covariates, and a forecast horizon; a forecaster formats and normalizes inputs, invokes a backend model, and returns point and quantile forecasts. TimesFM 3.0 provides PyTorch and MLX runtimes, while 2.5 retains Torch and Flax implementations plus optional XReg covariates. Archived v1 code also supports adapter-based fine-tuning. Some orchestration details are inferred from documented interfaces because sampled excerpts are incomplete.
